requirement.statement: Coalesce rapid keystrokes so the search endpoint is called once the typing stops.

criteria.statement: Rapid calls collapse into one call after the wait.
A pending call can be cancelled when the surface goes away.

proposed.summary: Call the existing useDebounced hook from the search surface.

candidates.summary: src/hooks.mjs already exports a debounce with a cancel.

savings.claim: Removes the 3 duplicate debounce implementations counted in the audit.

candidates.summary: The surface already waits for a blur event before searching.
